newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * Prime Minister Victor Ciorbea started talks with trade unions on the government's programme, price increases and measures to offset their effects.

* President Emil Constantinescu will make an official visit to Poland on January 13-14 following an invitation from his counterpart Aleksander Kwasniewski, foreign ministry spokeswoman Gilda Lazar told a news conference.

* Top officials of the Romanian and Turkish foreign ministries will start consultations on January 10 on Turkey's support for Romania's integration into NATO in the first wave of expansion, Lazar said.
* Romania and Ukraine will resume treaty talks starting January 11 in Bucharest, the spokeswoman said. Romanian secretary of state Dumitru Ceausu will meet his counterpart Anton Buteiko.
Lazar said some 90 percent of the treaty text was already finalised.
* The foreign ministry denied media reports saying Romania came under the spotlight from G7 countries for fear it was on the verge of economic collapse.
